resources.string: BMR (Basal Metabolic Rate) is the amount of energy the body burns while completely at rest. This figure is useful as a basis for regulating eating patterns or diets.
BMR Calculation Results: Weight: %1$s kg Height: %2$s cm Age: %3$s years Gender: %4$s Total BMR: %5$.0f kcal/day
